episodes.title: Tokyo Blade
episodes.synopsis: Il palcoscenico è pronto. Gli attori sono pronti. E il sipario si alza sullo spettacolo, Tokyo Blade. Tuttavia, c'è un'altra storia a parte la pièce: quella degli attori stessi.

episodes.title: Telefono senza fili
episodes.synopsis: La creatrice di Tokyo Blade non è contenta dell'infedele adattamento del suo manga e chiede una revisione dell'intera sceneggiatura. Mancano però solo venti giorni all'apertura.

episodes.title: Riscrittura
episodes.synopsis: Il tempo stringe e sorge una domanda: un fedele adattamento di Tokyo Blade o uno su misura per il teatro? In mezzo alla tensione, solo una persona può convincere Abiko a scendere a compromessi.

episodes.title: Recitazione emotiva
episodes.synopsis: Abiko e GOA collaborano su una nuova sceneggiatura e ora la pressione è sugli attori per dare vita alla sceneggiatura. Tuttavia, Aqua affronta presto una sfida inaspettata durante le prove.

episodes.title: Si alza il sipario
episodes.synopsis: Aqua si confida con Akane, rivelando le sue vere motivazioni. Giura di rimanere al suo fianco, ma questo legame sempre più profondo fa sì che la rivalità di Akane con Kana si intensifichi.

episodes.title: Crescita
episodes.synopsis: Melt si rammarica della sua scarsa recitazione in Sweet Today e giura di migliorare in Tokyo Blade. Tuttavia, come può un attore scadente distinguersi tra quelli eccezionali?

episodes.title: Sole
episodes.synopsis: Akane è diventata attrice perché idolatrava Kana e voleva essere come lei. Tuttavia, non si dovrebbero mai incontrare i propri eroi.

episodes.title: Innesco
episodes.synopsis: Il loro passato ha plasmato la loro recitazione. Kana voleva brillare come attrice, ma è scesa a compromessi per essere utile. Nel frattempo, il trauma infantile di Aqua ha portato a un metodo di recitazione unico.

episodes.title: Sogno
episodes.synopsis: Gli attori hanno brillato brillantemente e il sipario è calato su un'opera teatrale di successo, preparando il terreno per la prossima esibizione mentre Aqua e Taiki spingono il regista per avere delle risposte.

episodes.title: Liberazione
episodes.synopsis: Taiki scopre una connessione sorprendente, ma rivela qualcosa che Aqua non si aspettava. Nel frattempo, Ruby spera che una persona in particolare noti la crescente fama di B Komachi.

episodes.title: Libertà
episodes.synopsis: Aqua non deve vivere per vendicarsi e può finalmente guardare verso un futuro migliore. Ma cosa significa questo per le relazioni che ha coltivato alla ricerca di un assassino?

episodes.title: Riunione
episodes.synopsis: Il luogo in cui un tempo vivevano Goro e Sarina e dove sono nati i gemelli, Aqua e Ruby visitano Miyazaki per la prima volta in più di una dozzina di anni. D'altra parte, Ruby continua a nascondere nel suo cuore i suoi sentimenti per Goro.

episodes.title: Preghiera
episodes.synopsis: Una scoperta raccapricciante dà finalmente ad Aqua la conclusione di cui ha bisogno per iniziare un nuovo capitolo della sua vita. Ma mentre entra in un domani più luminoso, inizia la discesa di Ruby nell'oscurità.

info.title: Change!! Shin Getter Robo: L'ultimo giorno del mondo
info.synopsis: Nel corso degli anni, l'umanità è progredita grazie allo sviluppo dei Raggi Getter ideati dal Dr. Saotome. In poco tempo, però, questa invenzione ha attirato l'attenzione di una razza aliena mutaforma decisa ad appropriarsene per conquistare la Terra. Dopo una prima battaglia svoltasi sulla Luna, gli alieni vennero sconfitti, ma allo stesso tempo Ryōma Nagare venne accusato dell'omicidio di Saotome. Otto anni dopo, però, il dottore ricompare misteriosamente assieme agli alieni minacciando di distruggere la Terra. L'unico modo per fermarlo è rimettere insieme la squadra e utilizzare il Getter Robot.

episodes.title: RINASCITA - Centro ricerche Saotome: la fortezza del male
episodes.synopsis: Nel passato la razza umana aveva combattuto sulla Luna una serie di terribili battaglie contro una misteriosa minaccia aliena. Anni dopo, come una fenice dalle ceneri, lo scienziato scopritore dei raggi Getter, il dottor Saotome, ritorna incredibilmente dalla morte per cercare vendetta contro coloro che impiegano le sue scoperte per ambizioni personali, e si barrica nella sua base-fortezza, il Laboratorio Saotome, protetto da un intero esercito di Getter Robot G al suo servizio.

episodes.title: MINACCIA - Shin Dragon, dio o demone?
episodes.synopsis: Il Dottor Saotome porta avanti il suo diabolico piano di vendetta contro la razza umana, contrastato da un indomito Ryoma, che viene presto affiancato dagli altri due componenti della squadra Getter, Musashi e Hayato.

episodes.title: DISTRUZIONE - Addio, Getter!
episodes.synopsis: Cowen e Stinger rivelano la loro natura di Invasori: dopo aver massacrato il Consiglio di Sicurezza delle Nazioni Unite scagliano sul Giappone una terribile bomba a Raggi Getter.

episodes.title: VIOLENZA - La terra trema!
episodes.synopsis: Sono passati tredici anni dalla terribile esplosione. La Terra è ridotta a una landa desolata e i pochi sopravvissuti hanno trovato rifugio nel sottosuolo per sfuggire alle avverse condizioni del pianeta.

episodes.title: ATTACCO - I nuovi guerrieri!
episodes.synopsis: Il misterioso Go invita Kei e Benkei a salire sullo Shin Getter mentre in superficie la battaglia infuria, resa ancora più feroce dalla comparsa di un'enorme fortezza mobile simile ad una torre, comandata dall'ex membro della squadra Getter, Hayato e dal Prof. Shikishima. I due sono a capo anche della squadra di robot che sta combattendo contro gli Invasori.

episodes.title: INCUBO - La verità rivelata!
episodes.synopsis: Cowen e Stinger , assieme al redivivo Dott. Saotome, tramano su come impossessarsi dello Shin Dragon. Mentre il gruppo si reca a far visita a Benkei, Saotome fa la sua spettacolare comparsa e rivendica la paternità di Kai, svelando che in realtà la ragazza è Genki, ossia colui che si credeva essere il figlio minore di Saotome.

episodes.title: BATTAGLIA - L'esercito dei robot!
episodes.synopsis: Come un esercito di zombie, i rottami dei robot dell'esercito di Hayato risorgono, posseduti dagli Invasori che si trasformano in Metal Beast, che ingaggiano una terribile battaglia con l'esercito dei robot, che deve vedersela con le proprie armi migliorate dai mostri alieni.

episodes.title: MORTE - La distesa di ghiaccio si tinge di sangue!
episodes.synopsis: L'esercito dei Robot si mobilita per cercare su tutto il globo lo svuggevole Shin Dragon ed anche il gruppo di Benkei partecipa in funzione di squadra indipendente.

episodes.title: TRAPPOLA - Scontro fra i grattacieli!
episodes.synopsis: La gigantesca astronave chiamata Balena si dirige sulla città di New York, ormai devastata, in risposta ad un segnale di aiuto. La richiesta di soccorso si rivela ben presto una trappola degli Invasori ed ancora una volta è il misterioso Getter di colore nero a salvare la situazione. Dalla cabina emerge il pilota, e con grande sorpresa di tutti, ecco apparire un giovane Ryoma Nagare.

episodes.title: DISCESA - Il demonio solca i mari del sud
episodes.synopsis: La squadra Getter, dopo una disperata battaglia fra i devastati grattacieli di Manhattan, riesce a spazzare via tutti gli Invasori facendo detonare il Reattore a Raggi Getter della Balena.

episodes.title: INVASIONE - Gli spiriti tornano alla vita!!
episodes.synopsis: Lo Shin Getter ingaggia una furiosa battaglia contro lo Shin Dragon, ma con due soli piloti è una lotta impari e disperata. Nel frattempo Hayato inizia ad evacuare la Torre per dare inizio al suo piano suicida contro il nemico. Il Professor Shikishima effettua dei test su Go e scopre che il cervello del ragazzo è strutturato per essere legato psichicamente allo Shin Dragon.

episodes.title: TERRORE - Un'anima caduta in frantumi!!
episodes.synopsis: Go conduce Kei e Gai dentro lo Shin Dragon, dove ognuno prende posto in una postazione di comando dalla quale viene attivata la macchina. Lentamente, lo Shin Dragon inizia ad assorbire tutta l'energia Getter del pianeta, ripulendolo dalla contaminazione. Alcuni Invasori superstiti tentano di raggiungere il Dragon, ma lo Shin Getter assieme alla squadra di Schwarz li tengono a bada.

episodes.title: LAMPI - La fine dell'evoluzione
episodes.synopsis: Quando tutto sembra ormai perduto, dalle nuvole emerge lo Shin Dragon, dall'aspetto di un gigantesco drago con un Getter incastrato sul dorso. Sulla testa del drago si erge lo Shin Getter, sano e salvo. Arrivato nello spazio, lo Shin Dragon spara una cannonata di energia Getter contro Ganimede, facendolo esplodere in un solo colpo assieme alla maggior parte degli Invasori; il Dragon assorbe i BT di Kei e Gai, che si ritrovano nelle postazioni di comando occupate in precedenza, stupiti nel ritrovare il redivivo Go ai comandi.

Finalmente, in un giorno primaverile, la loro relazione ha una svolta.

episodes.title: Se dovesse vincere lui
episodes.synopsis: A gym uniform mix-up leads to a heart-pounding exchange. Later, Haryu raises the stakes for Taiki’s match, while Kyo makes a secret request to Chinatsu.

episodes.title: L'acquario
episodes.synopsis: With both players going neck and neck on the court, will Taiki win his match against Kishi — and will Chinatsu invite him to the aquarium?

episodes.title: Augurami buona fortuna
episodes.synopsis: On her way to return Chinatsu's mobile phone, Hina makes a shocking discovery. The gymnast faces mounting pressure while struggling with her new feelings.

episodes.title: Posso prenderne uno?
episodes.synopsis: Chinatsu overhears rival players speak poorly about her recent game. Later, Hina playfully steals a bite from Taiki — and Chinatsu notices from afar.

episodes.title: Segna un punto!
episodes.synopsis: As Taiki strives to make it to the nationals, Chinatsu gives him a word of encouragement. Later, Haryu and Taiki face top players in the doubles match.

episodes.synopsis: Frustrated with his loss to Sajikawa High, Taiki overworks himself studying for midterms and falls ill, when Chinatsu suddenly appears in his room.

episodes.title: È sbagliato
episodes.synopsis: After a sleepless night, Taiki asks Haryu for relationship advice. Later, Chinatsu realizes her recent behavior might hinder her dream and trouble others.

episodes.title: È da sfigati!

episodes.title: Le ragazze sono fatte così
episodes.synopsis: Taiki attends the fireworks festival with Hina and is surprised by her new look and shyness. Later, he unexpectedly bumps into Chinatsu with a lost child.

episodes.title: Voglio un vero scambio
episodes.synopsis: Taiki worries about a potential misunderstanding after Chinatsu departs. At the badminton nationals, he learns more about Karen and Haryu's relationship.

episodes.title: Cosa c'entra?
episodes.synopsis: While Chinatsu faces immense pressure at the nationals, Hina cheers up a worried Taiki with a game where the loser shares an embarrassing secret.

episodes.title: 26 agosto
episodes.synopsis: Despite it being her birthday, Chinatsu still seems a little down. Taiki takes her somewhere special — but the weather might have other plans.

episodes.title: Una persona sleale
episodes.synopsis: As a new school term begins, the school buzzes with preparations for the upcoming festival. Chinatsu reflects on her restless feelings towards Taiki.

episodes.title: E invece ci tengo tantissimo
episodes.synopsis: Upon learning of an upcoming practice match with Sajikawa High, Taiki worries about facing Yusa gain. Chinatsu and Hina promise their support.

episodes.title: Lo so
episodes.synopsis: Sajikawa High arrives for the much-anticipated practice match. As Chinatsu watches from the sidelines, she thinks about how far Taiki has come.

episodes.title: Ho già un impegno
episodes.synopsis: Just before the school festival starts, Taiki goes for his usual morning jog and finds Chinatsu practicing nearby. She extends a surprising invitation.

episodes.title: Migliore amico
episodes.synopsis: After a blissful time with Chinatsu, Nishida's ominous fortune comes true! His classmate playing the prince can't perform, so Taiki must take on the role.

episodes.title: Fiorire
episodes.synopsis: While rumors swirl around Taiki and Hina, Chinatsu seems unfazed. However, while spending the night at Karen's, the basketballer shares her true thoughts.

episodes.title: Inota!
episodes.synopsis: After learning about Hina's unrequited feelings for Taiki, Ayame decides to help — and the perfect chance arises at the upcoming autumn training camp!

episodes.title: Un turbinio di pensieri
episodes.synopsis: An exciting card game with friends leaves Taiki's head spinning. He mulls over his feelings for Chinatsu and Hina as the training camp continues.

episodes.title: Montagne russe
episodes.synopsis: Hina experiences a roller coaster of emotions over her affection for Taiki and, thanks to Ayame, gets a chance to be alone with him on the last night.

episodes.title: Non importa
episodes.synopsis: Ayame faces the consequences of her meddling and tries all sorts of ways to console Hina. Meanwhile, Taiki strengthens his resolve and asks Chinatsu out.

info.title: Lupin III - L'amore da capo - Fujiko's Unlucky Days (ITA)
info.synopsis: La bella Fujiko vuole entrare in possesso del cosiddetto Uovo di Colombo, un prezioso oggetto contenente energia, capace di intervenire sul corpo umano e sui fenomeni atmosferici. Fujiko, allora, memorizza e poi distrugge i Columbus Files, ovvero informazioni che conducono al leggendario tesoro, ma purtroppo, in seguito ad un incidente, perde la memoria. A prendersi cura di lei è una cacciatrice di tesori di nome Rosaria, anch'ella in cerca dell'Uovo. Lupin, Goemon e Jigen hanno il compito di proteggere la sventurata Fujiko dai numerosi malviventi intenzionati a mettere le mani sull'antica e potente reliquia. Tra questi vi è Nazaroff, un criminale che cercherà in tutti i modi di ostacolarli.

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis:
Fujiko and Lupin are enjoying a romantic dinner together; as usual, Lupin's appetites include getting a taste of Fujiko's latest plan. Fujiko has uncovered the "Columbus Files" that tell of an incredible treasure known appropriately as the "Columbus Egg". Before Lupin can learn more, they are attacked by a helicopter squadron led by Nazaroff. Lupin and Fujiko end up hanging onto the edge of a cliff, but Fujiko falls to earth after a gunshot severs the rope attaching her to Lupin.
A young woman named Rosaria is handing over a piece of sunken treasure to a buyer. She returns home to find an uninvited guest... Fujiko! However, Fujiko has amnesia and is haunted by frightening images of being chased by Nazaroff's men and of the contents of the Columbus Files. Can Lupin restore Fujiko's memories to find the Columbus Egg as well as for her own sake? And why is Rosaria determined to find the Egg for herself?

info.title: Trapezium
info.synopsis: Yuu Azuma, una liceale, mira a diventare una idol. Per realizzare il suo sogno si dà quattro semplici regole: non sarà attiva sui social media, non avrà un fidanzato, non si distinguerà a scuola e farà amicizia con belle ragazze del nord, del sud, est e Ovest.

info.title: Hiwou War Chronicles
info.synopsis: Sono passati ormai otto anni da quando le prime navi occidentali hanno iniziato a visitare il Giappone del XIX secolo, determinando la diffusione di bambole meccaniche e macchine a vapore in tutto il paese. Sfortunatamente, i Fujin hanno sfruttato queste tecnologie per affermarsi sempre di più tramite l'uso in battaglia delle bambole, arrivando a distruggere anche il villaggio di un giovane meccanico di nome Hiwou. Quest'ultimo, dopo essere scappato assieme ai suoi amici tramite una bambola gigante di nome Homura, deciderà di intraprendere un lungo viaggio alla ricerca di suo padre per riportare la pace nel paese.

info.synopsis: Per salvare sua madre, gravemente malata, Dong Cui Can stringe un patto con un misterioso sconosciuto, scambiando i suoi anni rimanenti per i suoi. Miracolosamente, lo sconosciuto non solo riporta in vita la madre di Cui Can, ma la ringiovanisce fino ai suoi 20 anni. Con una seconda possibilità, Yan Jin Yu è determinata a vivere ogni momento al massimo, mentre Cui Can promette di trascorrere il resto dei suoi giorni ripagando sua madre per i sacrifici fatti per crescerlo.

info.title: Bocchi the Rock! (ITA)
info.synopsis: Hitori Gotou è una liceale che inizia a imparare a suonare la chitarra in quanto il suo sogno è di entrare a far parte di una band, ma è talmente timida da non avere nemmeno un amico. Ma il suo sogno potrebbe avverarsi in seguito all'incontro con Nijika Ijichi, una ragazza che suona la batteria ed è alla ricerca proprio di un chitarrista per la band in cui suona.

episodes.title: Yojouhan Time Machine Blues
episodes.synopsis: Theatrical version of the TV series. On a hot summer day in Kyoto, a young man walks toward his apartment, dreaming of turning on the air conditioner and cooling down. But before he can turn his dream into reality, disaster naturally strikes in the form of Ozu, who spills soda all over the remote. With the air conditioner rendered completely unusable, the man and his friends are left to suffer in the terrible August heat. Just when all hope seems lost, the group finds a true-to-life time machine in their storage room. Not knowing the dire consequences of doing so, they decide to travel back to the past and grab the remote before Ozu even has a chance to destroy it. What awaits them on the other side is a staggering adventure none of them are prepared for.

info.title: Exception
info.synopsis: In un lontano futuro l'umanità ha abbandonato la terra per emigrare in un'altra galassia. Mentre l'umanità intraprende il viaggio secolare per raggiungere la sua nuova casa, una navicella vuota viene mandata a velocità insostenibili dagli uomini in prossimità del pianeta scelto per sostituire la Terra. A quel punto, una stampante 3D organica stampa le copie di alcuni esseri umani accuratamente selezionati, identiche alle persone originali in ogni dettaglio, persino nei ricordi. La loro missione è terraformare il pianeta in modo che l'umanità, al suo arrivo, abbia un luogo da abitare. Tuttavia un brillamento solare altera la stampa di uno dei membri dell'equipaggio, Lewis, dando origine ad un mostro privo di raziocinio che mette in pericolo l'equipaggio e la missione. Ma questo Lewis è davvero un mostro, o è rimasto qualcosa di umano in lui?

episodes.title: Collusion

episodes.title: Investigation

info.title: Oh! My Goddess: The Adventures of Mini-Goddess
info.synopsis: Una vasta raccolta delle avventure delle Dee presenti nella serie anime e manga Ah My Goddess. Parodie di altre opere e un gran numero di battute permeano questa serie di corti, in cui le Dee si divertono a tormentare e passare il tempo con il loro amico Gan, il topo.

episodes.title: Let`s Tell Your Fortune
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan the rat is in need of a female companion. To help him, Urd arrives with a crystal ball and offers to predict Gan-chan's future spouse. However, Urd's predictions are all inanimate objects. She finally settles upon a kettle, and Gan-chan marries Mrs. Kettle. Urd gives the kettle a voice-over and legs during the honeymoon, but Gan-chan insists on Mrs. Kettle having her own voice. However, once Mrs. Kettle can speak, she declares that she has fallen for another kettle and elopes, leaving Gan-chan single again.

episodes.title: Secret Treasure in the Attic, Part I
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan, Urd, and Skuld laze around because they are bored out of their minds. However, when a rat falls through the ceiling and mutters about a treasure before collapsing unconscious, they all become excited and decide to go treasure hunting. Skuld builds mechas for the entire gang, and they go to explore the attic. However, they get attacked by a large rat.

episodes.title: Secret Treasure in the Attic, Part II
episodes.synopsis: The gang does battle with the rat, but their attacks are largely ineffective in part due to the design of the mechas. They try to escape, but the rat calls in reinforcements and blocks their path. Gan-chan is volunteered to act as a distraction. A piece of cheese is strapped to his mecha and he manages to distract the rat gang. Urd and Skuld find the treasure, but it turns out to be a windup doll of a golden Buddha statue.

episodes.title: Let`s Fly in the Sky
episodes.synopsis: When Gan-chan expresses a wish to "fly like the birds", Skuld and Urd build him a series of progressively more complex flying machines, paralleling the history of flight. The devices begin with Urd's attempt to build Icarus' wings, followed by Skuld constructing the Montgolfier brothers' balloon, Otto Lilienthal's glider, Samuel Langley's (unsuccessful) Aerodrome and, ultimately, the Bell X-1, as Belldandy gives the history of flight. However, Gan-chan is still unsatisfied and wishes to travel to space.

episodes.title: Let`s Fly Into Space
episodes.synopsis: Continuing on from the previous episode, Gan-chan is launched into space by Urd and Skuld in a Saturn-style rocket. He orbits around Earth before performing a moon landing, quoting Neil Armstrong's famous line. He plants a flag and takes a moon rock before returning to his ship. Urd and Skuld convince him to fly to deep space, but they leave him when Belldandy announces that dinner is ready, leaving Gan-chan alone in deep space.

episodes.title: Slimming Down! Go!
episodes.synopsis: After having gained large amounts of weight, Gan-chan is unable to fit into his hole in the wall. He begs Skuld and Urd to help him slim down. Skuld tries several inventions, including Mr. Sauna, Mr. Icy Bath, and Mr. 4000 Years, but they all fail. Urd gives Gan-chan a pill that causes him to exercise. He exercises furiously, and collapses exhausted after crossing the entire world. However, when everybody wakes up the next morning, they discover that Gan-chan ate like a pig following his exercise and regained his weight.

episodes.title: Gabira, the Giant Monster: The Birth
episodes.synopsis: After eating a moldy cake, Gan-chan becomes ill. Urd and Skuld attempt to cure him using their potions and inventions, but to no avail. They try sprinkling salt, giving him exercise pills, silica gel, and a vacuum, but all to no avail. Finally, Urd seems to have solved the problem — only to discover that, as a side effect, Gan-chan has turned into mini-Godzilla named Gabira.

episodes.title: Gabira, the Giant Monster: The Final Battle
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan, in the form of Gabira, heads towards the kitchen. Urd multiples herself to form an army, and Urd and Skuld set up multiple lines of defense to defeat Gabira. Using toy tanks, they slow down Gabria, but fail to stop him. When the goddesses retreat to their final line of defense and play rock music, the mold is disgusted by Gan-chan's lack of rhythm when he attempts to dance. The stereo overloads however. Keiichi finally destroys Gabira by exposing him to sunlight.

episodes.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls: The Mysterious Can of Food
episodes.synopsis: The goddesses and Gan-chan find a can containing a vile-looking green slime which surprisingly tastes totally delicious. But the origin of this strange food comes as an even greater surprise — a mysterious vending machine which has appeared at the temple. Upon venturing inside, Skuld, Urd and Gan-chan surprise the operators, who eject them from the machine, transform it into a spaceship, and rapidly depart from the temple.

episodes.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls: The Secret of the Diamond
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan is having a bad day. Urd notices the ring Gan-chan has and asks Gan-chan if she can have it, and he gladly agrees. However, the bad luck almost immediately transfers to Urd, leading her to conclude that the diamond on the ring is cursed. They try to place a spiritual barrier on the ring, but it fails. The gang then attempts to exorcise the spirit in the ring, but a black cat emerges, gives them a business card, takes the ring, and leaves.

episodes.title: Gabira, the Gant Monster: The Strike Back
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan has a relapse transformation into the monstrous Gabira. Urd and Skuld, using the strategy that destroyed Gabira before, bathe him sunlight. Unfortunately, it makes Gabira even stronger. Skuld unleashes a golden mecha version of Gabria after having run out of ideas. They grapple, but then become friends, reconciling their differences and leaving the temple grounds.

episodes.title: Let`s Play Baseball!
episodes.synopsis: Urd and Skuld argue about who is better at baseball. They duplicate themselves to make teams. Gan-chan and Belldandy commentate to a crowd of fake fans while the two battle. The game goes into extra innings, and Urd and Skuld begin to play in ridiculous fashions, like imitating the tornado pitch of the Tasmanian Devil. Urd then disappears for her "ultimate pitch," and the rest all imitate her, leaving the stadium deserted.

episodes.title: Urd`s Babysitting Journal
episodes.synopsis: Urd babysits three little rats, named Ichiko, Jiro, and Juicy. When they all want to play different games, Urd replicates herself. When Urd makes an obedience pill, Juicy forces her to eat it, and it backfires. A thunderstorm arrives, to the terror of the young rats, but Urd reassures them. When they try to nap, Urd and Juicy snore so loudly that the other rats wake up. Finally, when it's time for Urd to leave, she promises to come back and play.

episodes.title: The Proposal Scheme
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan has fallen in love with Kaoru, a pink female rat, and has a date. He is extremely nervous, so Belldandy gives him a pill. Urd creates costumes for Gan-chan, who decides upon a collared bowtie and a red rose. Urd casts a spell on the rose so that Kaoru will love him forever. Gan-chan forgets the rose, however, and when Urd attempts to return it to him, he accidentally proposes to Urd instead of Kaoru, who leaves, devastated.

episodes.title: Welcome, Newlyweds!
episodes.synopsis: Urd and Gan-chan enjoy their newly wed life, that is until the magic rose petals start to fall down.

episodes.title: Phone Me, Darling!
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan tries to clean Keiichi's desk, but trips, bruises himself, and begins hiccuping. Urd cures him with an energy pill, and Gan-chan completes his cleaning. The credits roll, but Gan-chan remarks that it is too early for the show to end. Time moves in reverse, and when Gan-chan repeats his attempt to clean Keiichi's desk he is injured again. Skuld cures Gan-chan this time with a robot named Mr. Helpful. The credits roll again, Gan-chan interrupts once more, and the sequence repeats yet again. This time Gan-chan turns for aid to Belldandy, who orders Gan-chan to ask Skuld and Urd for a cure. When the credits roll for the final time, Belldandy has not yet cured Gan-chan.

episodes.title: SOS in the Big Snowfield, Part One
episodes.synopsis: The episode starts with Gan-chan, Skuld, and Urd walking in the snow, disenheartened and without food. Gan-chan faints from exhaustion, but Skuld refuses to abandon him. They use a ruler as a bridge to cross a cliff gap, but Gan-chan and Urd argue and the ruler breaks, sending them plummeting. Urd explains their situation: the air conditioner broke, but became overpowered after Skuld fixed it. Gan-chan wants to give up the quest to fix the air conditioner, but Skuld and Urd continue their mission.

episodes.title: SOS in the Big Snowfield, Part Two
episodes.synopsis: Skuld throws a paper clip over the cliff and Gan-chan begins to climb down, only to fall along the way. Gan-chan uses some bulletin board tacks to stop his fall and begins to climb. Skuld and Urd imitate him, and Urd remarks that they seem to be reenacting the movie Cliffhanger. They arrive at the air conditioner, but it fights back with a security system created by Skuld. The four eventually destroy it.

episodes.title: Kitchen Fighters
episodes.synopsis: The rats decide to have a martial arts championship. Gan-chan, emulating Bruce Lee, defeats his first opponent by using nunchucks given to him by Urd, his trainer. Skuld enters Banpei into the competition, and Banpei wins several rounds. In the final match between Gan-chan and Banpei, Banpei has the advantage until Gan-chan drinks a bottle of sake and begins using Jackie Chan's Drunken Master technique. However, the time runs out for the match, and the last rat standing, Jose Mendoda, is declared the winner.

episodes.title: Gan-chan`s Magnificent Days
episodes.synopsis: When Gan-chan declares that he starts every day with Belldandy's morning tea, Urd begins following him as he hunts for food. When Gan-chan wakes up from a nap, he rushes to tea and repeats his routine. Urd, annoyed, argues with Gan-chan about how simple and regular the routine is.

episodes.title: Ah, My Buddah!
episodes.synopsis: Urd incorrectly believes Skuld has fallen in love with a large Buddha statue, so she miniaturizes and animates it. The statue thinks the goddesses and Gan-chan are his disciples, and declares they must follow his teachings. Buddha notices how serene Belldandy is and hits the others, telling them to be more like Belldandy. When Keiichi returns, they revert Buddha to his original state.

episodes.title: The Story of Gan-chan: Love Me to the Bone
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan announces that he has a new girlfriend named Koharu-chan. Urd and Skuld interview him as a news crew would, and discover that he is attracted to the way she eats. Urd and Skuld then discover, to their disgust, that Koharu-chan eats everything offered to her. When Gan-chan tries to kiss Koharu, she engulfs half of his body with her mouth.

episodes.title: Let`s Form a Band! Side A
episodes.synopsis: Urd and Skuld need a drummer for their new band. Urd replicates herself and Skuld makes a drum machine, but Gan-chan demands to be drummer, so Urd tests his drumming skill. As they select a vocalist, Urd, Skuld, and Gan-chan all try to outdo each other. Belldandy arrives and becomes the singer after demonstrating her mouth recorder. They argue over the name of the band before deciding on "Goddess Fantastic Band".

episodes.title: Let`s Form a Band! Side B
episodes.synopsis: To pick a leader for the band, the characters try several techniques that are all rigged. They finally decide to vote for the leader and Belldandy wins. They sell tickets for the band's concert and fix a mistake on the posters. The concert is attended by a huge crowd of rats, who pay with food. Gan-chan is nervous about the concert, but Skuld and Urd use inventions and drugs to calm him down.

episodes.title: Chu Hard: Gan-chan`s Desperate Situation
episodes.synopsis: The goddesses ask Gan-chan to guard the refrigerator, after securing it with Skuld's Mr. Safety. The goddesses' paranoia is well-founded; while they are gone, Gan-chan falls asleep. A group of rats attack and hold Gan-chan's rat friends hostage. He wakes up from his nap, is discovered, and flees. The terrorist rats set up a computer system to hack Mr. Safety, and Gan-chan infiltrates the group of computer rats.

episodes.title: Chu Hard 2: Descent of the Devil
episodes.synopsis: The computer rats attempt several passwords to unlock Mr. Safety, but none are successful. The rats are led by Marller, who suggests the use of heavy artillery. Gan-chan subdues the terrorist rat squad, but Marller arrives and easily defeats Gan-chan. Just in time, the goddesses return. They greet Marller as a friend and talk with her, so she gives up. They open the fridge and reveal a cheesecake, which they share and eat.

episodes.title: Pop! Goes the Urd
episodes.synopsis: Urd and Gan-chan host a chat show with questions from viewers. After answering one question, they are interrupted by an advertisement from Skuld Electronics Group. They attempt to answer two more questions, but the answers take too long. When Gan-chan asks Belldandy if she likes rats, Urd discovers that the "viewer questions" are all written by Gan-chan.

episodes.title: Rainy Day
episodes.synopsis: While watching the rain outside, Urd watches a crow fly away. She takes a walk with an umbrella and rides down the river on a hat. She walks down the beach, travels on the subway, and walks outside, seeing the crow again. Then she sees Skuld, Belldandy, and Gan-chan, and runs toward them, smiling.

episodes.title: Let`s Meet in Our Dreams
episodes.synopsis: Urd dreams that she defeats Marller and saves the world from destruction. Skuld creates Mr. Dream TV, which allows others to see the subject's dreams. When they examine Gan-chan, his dream is so boring that Skuld modifies it so that he dreams about Belldandy confessing her love to him. In the dream, he makes negative comments about Skuld and Urd, so they attack him. They attach Belldandy to Mr. Dream TV and the episode ends with the other characters staring at the monitor in shock.

episodes.title: Female Detective Skuld`s First Case... Mystery of the Three Stolen Treasures: The Dangerous Trap Hidden in the Steamy Smoke!
episodes.synopsis: Skuld the detective looks for her stolen ice cream, Gan-chan's stolen cheese, and Urd's stolen pickled squid. They investigate Marller, but she is not the thief. Skuld tests two devices to catch the thief at the scene of the crime, but the characters fall asleep without catching anybody. Belldandy appears with a hot pot containing all of the stolen items, and the characters enjoy it while Marller looks on, disgusted.

episodes.title: Goddess Love Theater: Goddess Blade
episodes.synopsis: Skuld, dressed as a medieval knight, attacks a castle. Gan-chan, a sorcerer from the castle, declares that he has kidnapped Belldandy. Skuld attacks, but Gan-chan is struck down by Urd, who claims that he was being controlled by someone else. Marller appears, attacking Urd and summoning a large rat dragon. The dragon disobeys Marller and attacks the entire group, but Belldandy appears and defeats it.

episodes.title: Quick Fix Division of the Tariki Hongan Temple
episodes.synopsis: Urd, Skuld, and Gan-chan open a "Quick Fix" club. A pink rat is their first customer. Her son is stuck in a gap in the kitchen, and they try to save him with a variety of strange methods. Skuld begins building a robot, and Urd gives Gan-chan a pill. They fiddle with their plans for so long that Belldandy saves the young rat instead. Wondering how Belldandy did it, they try to recreate the situation by stuffing Gan-chan into the hole.

episodes.title: Fishing Journal
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan is fishing in the bathtub when Urd becomes intrigued. Gan-chan explains to Urd how to fish, but Urd ignores him and begins fishing in a different way. Gan-chan is more successful at first, but Urd ups the stakes by using a shark lure. They begin to catch larger and larger fish, keeping track on an electronic scoreboard, but the power goes out and their scores are lost. Together, they reel in an extremely large fish, who heads toward Gan-chan. He declares victory, but the fish swallows him.

episodes.title: Give Me Some Servants
episodes.synopsis: Marller arrives with a team of rats intent on causing chaos. Her rat henchmen capture Urd, Skuld, and Gan-chan with a bottle of sake, ice cream, and cheese respectively. She tries to capture Belldandy, but Belldandy has gone to make tea. When Marller checks on her henchmen, they are having a party with their captives. The Diamond of Fear, which Marller was trying to activate, shocks Marller instead.

episodes.title: Rules of the Ninja: Volume I
episodes.synopsis: Marller summons new servants (three ninja girls) from a fighting game at an arcade. She orders them to attack the goddesses, and they disappear to find their targets' weaknesses. They sneak into the temple but are found by Skuld's Mr. Patrol, who tries to detain them. However, Mr. Patrol fails, and the goddesses wonder what is wrong with the robot. The ninjas complete their scouting and prepare a plan.

episodes.title: Rules of the Ninja: Volume II
episodes.synopsis: The ninjas enter the temple, intent on causing chaos. Mr. Patrol attacks Urd, but Urd deflects the shot and knocks out Mr. Patrol. The characters discover that Urd is a fake. The fake Urd attacks Belldandy, but Belldandy hands her a 500-yen coin, and "Urd" dashes away. The goddesses ask the real Urd what is going on, but she has no idea. Mr. Patrol discovers the ninja girls on the ceiling, and the goddesses demand to know who they are. Before they answer, they notice the time and dash off to watch their favorite ninja TV show.

episodes.title: Urd vs. Urd
episodes.synopsis: Urd loses an earring and clones herself to find it. She orders her clones to find her earring while she takes a nap. When she wakes up, she discovers that only a few of her clones have returned and the others have rebelled against her. They are led by a clone who has Urd's other earring. She declares war on the other Urd, but they cannot win against each other. It deteriorates to rock, paper, scissors, but each game ends in a draw.

episodes.title: Gan-chan Runs For Election "Being Self-Made" Edition
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan is running in an election and is faring well against his opponent, Gon, due to the help of the goddesses. However, Marller appears and offers Gon help. Gon hosts a party for the rat leaders of the temple and wins them over easily with the help of the ninja girls (dressed as escorts). He also starts a smear campaign and incites a crowd against Gan-chan. The goddesses investigate, and Urd discovers Gon plotting with Marller.

episodes.title: Gan-chan Runs For Election "Time of Change" Edition
episodes.synopsis: The rats hold a public debate, and Gon shames Gan-chan for the material dug up by the smear campaign. Gan-chan is losing badly, but Urd arrives with the captured ninja girls. Urd pops truth pills into their mouths, and they reveal all. Belldandy charms everybody and Gon apologizes for his actions. Gan-chan and Gon make amends and promise to run a clean election. On Election Day, to everyone's surprise, Belldandy wins instead of either Gon or Gan-chan.

episodes.title: Urd`s Ultimate Diet
episodes.synopsis: When Urd finds that her skirt does not fit, she begins a diet. She tries magic pills, but Gan-chan comments on how those never work. Urd tries to keep busy with chores, but drinks so much sake that she regains her weight. She concentrates hard on forgetting to eat, but fails again. She eats tofu, but regains the weight by eating too much. She tries again with new ideas but they all fail; Skuld and Belldandy point out that goddesses cannot gain or lose weight and that the skirt shrunk.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday, Gan-chan
episodes.synopsis: On Gan-chan's birthday the goddesses prepare a great gift. They give him the Goddess Wish Maker, which grants three wishes before midnight. Asleep, Gan-chan dreams of a romantic encounter with Belldandy, but wakes up in the evening without having wished anything. Since the Wish Maker grants any wish it hears, it grants the wish of one of the goddesses. Gan-chan hurriedly tries to grant other wishes so that the Wish Maker does not grant them, but he loses another. As he tries to think of his final wish, he wastes his final wish by wishing for more time.

episodes.title: Ah! My Average College Student
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan ponders the "average college student" mentioned in the opening narration. Urd and Skuld attempt to explain but, to his surprise, the description sounds like himself—working part-time, partying, eating and sleeping, and falling in love. He asks to see the student, but he repeatedly misses Keiichi, the "average college student".

episodes.title: This Happens Once in a While
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan, Skuld, and Urd realize that the show is running even on their day off. They use several backdrops, but none of them work. Belldandy arrives with a script, but when they collaborate on the set's design, they end up arguing. When they finally agree to work together, they launch into outer space just as the credits roll.

episodes.title: Gan-chan the Locomotive
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan reads a number of train adventure books. He dreams that he is the Steam Locomotive 150 and travels on railroads while greeting the goddesses embodied as trains. Urd, as the Mallard Train, easily beats Gan-chan in a race. Skuld, as the Swiss Brienz Rothorn, climbs to the cupboard to snack. Gan-chan chases after her but to his dismay, he accidentally ends up at the roller coaster-like Extreme Thrill Ride Course.

episodes.title: The Miso Jar
episodes.synopsis: When Gan-chan gets stuck in a jar of miso sauce, he finds that the walls are too slippery to climb and too thick to break. He calls for help, but nobody hears him. He imagines what life would be like if he lived in the miso jar. Urd wants miso for her curry so she pours hot spices into the jar and stirs it, but does not take any miso out, so Gan-chan is still stuck in the jar. After falling unconscious, he manages to escape. He chases the goddesses while completely covered in miso, frightening them.

episodes.title: Deluxe Game of Life: Satellite Version
episodes.synopsis: The characters decide to play Life, but all of the game's actions happen in real life. Skuld opens a company, Urd goes on vacations, Gan-chan gets married and has children, and Belldandy studies. When they try to quit the game, they cannot figure out how. They declare bankruptcy but end up working on a farm until someone dies in peace.

episodes.title: Mekimeki High School Memorial
episodes.synopsis: Gan-chan desperately wants to experience stereotypical spring love, so he prays to God. As goddesses, Urd and Skuld wonder why he does not just ask them for help, but Skuld puts Gan-chan in her Dating Sim invention anyway. Inside the game, Gan-chan only eats and sleeps instead of entering dating scenarios, so Skuld forces him to "date". Gan-chan fails the scenarios several times until Skuld finally takes control of Gan-chan and completes them herself. He graduates after beating every scenario, but a tree falls on him, ending the game.

episodes.title: What`ll Happen Next?
episodes.synopsis: The gang wonders what to do for the final episode of the series, but reject each idea suggested. When they discuss death, Skuld reveals that Gan-chan has had various incarnations and has been cloned throughout the show. Gan-chan suddenly wakes up from his dreams repeatedly until Urd stops the redundant dream cycle. Belldandy suggests a party outside, so the goddesses have a picnic and they invite Gan-chan. They take a commemorative photo, but Gan-chan jumps in front of the camera, ruining the picture.

info.title: Detective Opera Milky Holmes: Summer Special
info.synopsis: Dopo un po’ di insistenza da parte di Irene e di suo padre e la mancanza di supporto da parte degli altri, Kokoro lascia ostinatamente il suo lavoro di detective di polizia per diventare un’idol. Presto però la vita da idol si rivela estenuante e comincia a sentire la mancanza della sua vecchia vita da detective. Quando Henriette nota la solitudine di Sherlock senza di lei, organizza il furto di una statua per convincere Kokoro a tornare in servizio.

info.title: Shutline
info.synopsis: Moon Shingun, che si guadagna da vivere riparando auto per strada, sta passando una giornata deludente finché non compare Jake Gillan con un’auto rotta. Jake lo squadra con attenzione mentre fa domande irritanti. Tuttavia, Shingun non può permettersi di perdere un cliente che gli offre un grosso pacco di contanti, così gli dà il suo contatto. L’obiettivo di Shingun è evitare i pericoli e sopravvivere giorno per giorno. Ben presto scopre che Jake è un membro di alto rango di una banda, e nonostante i suoi sforzi per stargli lontano, Jake sembra non avere alcuna intenzione di lasciarlo andare.

episodes.title: A Legitimate Job Admired by Everyone
episodes.synopsis: At a conference among industry leaders in Kaii countermeasures, Shigemoto's "Alice System" is rejected due to lack of proven results. He takes on a massive yet dangerous new project for himself to prove his abilities while questioning the industry's power dynamics and expectations. Meanwhile, a certain individual approaches Koshigaya with a suspicious proposal, putting her father on shaky ground.

episodes.title: No Logical Means of Exterminating This Kaii
episodes.synopsis: Kana and Koshigaya visit the RIMT to investigate and exterminate a new Kaii species. Guided by Vice Chief Akasaka, they face a bewildering and seemingly invincible Kaii specimen defying all common sense. Behind the scenes, ulterior motives surrounding magic power regulations cause tension as the Kaii unexpectedly mutates. With a strict time limit, Magilumiere's skills are put to the test.

episodes.title: Haven`t Seen Delusion Like This in Ages
episodes.synopsis: Magical Girls from Magilumiere and AST simultaneously face a rampaging new Kaii species. Koshigaya extends an olive branch to Tsuchiba, resulting in a clash of opinions that only sparks tension between their companies. The unknown Kaii rapidly mutates under the influence of magic power, after which a certain individual takes control as operator for the do-or-die battle ahead.

episodes.title: How Exceptional His Magical Girls Are
episodes.synopsis: An improvised collaboration between Magilumiere and AST engages in a do-or-die fight against the rapidly mutating Class C Kaii. Magilumiere's fluctuating defensive and offensive tactics upset conventional methods as Kana gathers real-time data during battle to take control. Through physicality, precise control, and high-level guidance, the seemingly unbalanced team devises a plan to counterattack.

episodes.title: Can`t Keep Acting Like a Rookie
episodes.synopsis: Magilumiere begins recruiting engineers to promote the Alice System. Kana struggles to convey the company's appeal while overseeing the interview process. This causes unexpected personnel to assemble, bringing the team a fresh atmosphere. When securing more talent proves difficult after serious attempts to strengthen their combat potential, Magilumiere heads to Kyoto for lectures and interviews.

episodes.title: You`re Not Fit for This Job
episodes.synopsis: In Kyoto, Magilumiere meets engineer candidate Yamimori, who boasts impressive skills but struggles with cooperation. While compatibility with the team is called into question, he appears to be hiding certain feelings about his childhood friend Sakae and his personal values. Meanwhile, during a festival at Tonomori Shrine, a ritual unleashes a Kaii while an ominous shadow lurks behind the scenes.

episodes.title: The Battle`s Already Over
episodes.synopsis: At the Tonomori Shrine ceremony's climax, an unknown Kaii suddenly invades a barrier once believed to be safe, enveloping the area in chaos. The barrier blocks outside forces, which separates Magilumiere's team. Makino and Akasaka are forced into a struggle within the barrier while Nikoyama searches for an opening outside. With time running out, each decision will greatly influence the outcome.

episodes.title: You Can Choose Where to Grow Up
episodes.synopsis: After gaining the trust of his allies, Yamimori takes action to fight the rampaging Kaii inside the sealed barrier. Makino and Akasaka also rechallenge the front lines to face the now-overpowered Kaii with harmonious teamwork and quick thinking. The dire situation demonstrates the skill and trust between Magical Girls and their engineers as the team marches onward with full hearts.

episodes.title: Are You Expecting Us to Sugarcoat This?
episodes.synopsis: The Kaii at Tonomori is revealed to be someone's act of sabotage promoting a scheme to ease magic regulations behind the scenes and manipulate public opinion. Then, the culprit emerges-someone entirely unexpected. While Yamimori becomes comfortable at Magilumiere, Kana decides to confront major industry norms and her own role in the process, sparking the onset of war on a much grander scale.

episodes.title: Do You Like Barley Spice?
episodes.synopsis: While deregulation advocates plot their next scheme, Magilumiere defies all precedents by waiting to ambush an enormous, unclassified, and highly irregular Kaii before it emerges. Koshigaya, Akasaka, and Makino struggle on the field as the Kaii's power escalates beyond all expectation while Nikoyama and Yamimori frantically work together on analysis and support from the operator's chair.

episodes.title: A Job You Can Bail on Has No Value
episodes.synopsis: As the battle in Tokyo Bay intensifies, Magilumiere's Magical Girls work together to take control. However, Tsuchiba from AST intervenes to turn the battle on its head with her ultra-powerful new magical device—"Wings"—aiming to single-handedly annihilate the target and contradict Magilumiere's cooperative combat style. Now, with tensions flaring, it's not just a fight against the Kaii anymore.

episodes.title: Glad I Became a Magical Girl
episodes.synopsis: Amidst the raging war, Magilumiere and AST finally decide to "cooperate" as Shigemoto gives AST full access to the Alice System's technology to combine both companies' power for shared use among their Magical Girls. Meanwhile, Tsuchiba nearly loses control of her magic. For the sake of future generations, new relationships and moral values drive everyone involved to fight with their hearts.

info.title: Seeing Double
info.synopsis: Seo-woo si ricongiunge con Ra-on, la ragazza di cui era innamorato ai tempi della scuola. A causa della sua timidezza, decide di chiedere al fratello gemello Jae-woo di corteggiarla al posto suo. Tuttavia, quello che inizialmente non prova alcun interesse per lei finisce inaspettatamente per innamorarsi di Ra-on. Ha così inizio un intenso triangolo amoroso nato da una dolce cotta non corrisposta, in cui i due fratelli si ritrovano a contendersi il cuore della stessa ragazza.

info.title: Io sono Teppei! (ITA)
info.synopsis: Teppei Uesugi è un ragazzo scapestrato e bighellone che non è mai andato a scuola e che vive in montagna, in mezzo alla natura selvaggia, con il padre ubriacone che pensa solo a cercare oro nelle miniere. Un giorno sua nonna, con l'aiuto della polizia, riesce a costringere Teppei a trasferirsi in città per frequentare la scuola. Per il ragazzo comincia dunque una nuova vita...
